pages.title: A Slice for Everyone
pages.text: Place one of the listed cakes or pies.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Follow the chosen cake’s recipe, then place it on a table. Placement earns completion; table decoration is your choice.

pages.title: Serve or recover a placed cake
pages.text: Right-click retrieves a whole placed cake, a knife cuts portions, and sneak-right-click eats it in place.

pages.title: Choose a cake display
pages.text: A Cake Stand holds a whole cake; the connecting display holds smaller portions. A Bread Box displays one food item and has a separate lid.

pages.title: A placed food portion counts only when it genuinely adds hunger a
pages.text: A placed food portion counts only when it genuinely adds hunger and changes the block portion. An empty right-click or retrieving the whole cake is not consumption.
